summary: Warface entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Warface: Clutch
entries.definitive_edition: Current official Warface: Clutch PC live client with region/server/build documented

primary.version: Current Warface: Clutch PC live client
primary.why: Warface: Clutch is a live-service multiplayer shooter, so the current PC client is the archive authority for fidelity, capture, and active content. Region, server, progression, monetization, and update state are part of the version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official PC client or Steam build. Record date, build/update, region/server, account/progression, PvP/PvE playlist availability, monetization state, graphics settings, anti-cheat/client, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console population, progression, or platform-specific service state.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture and current-service route.

secondary.what_to_play: Document from captures/patch notes only unless a preserved build exists.
secondary.why: Current Warface: Clutch has changed over time.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record build and server state. Do not treat old Warface captures as the current Clutch client without a date.
